verdict.rationale: Workable ships AI features (AI candidate recommendations, the Workable Agent, an MCP server), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documentation of a training opt-out, data-use policy, or AI-training controls. The "full control over your data" line describes API access, not model-training use, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
